item.title: Bird on a Branch
item.description: A monochrome pencil drawing of a plump bird perched on a short branch.
item.alt: Pencil drawing of a plump bird perched on a branch.

item.title: Blue-Winged Bird
item.description: A flat-colour bird with a black body and bright blue wing against an orange field.
item.alt: Black bird with a bright blue wing on an orange background.

item.title: Bold Leaf
item.description: A bold black outline drawing of a single leaf with branching veins.
item.alt: Bold black outline of a single veined leaf.

item.title: Bristly Seed Head
item.description: A monochrome drawing of a rounded bristly seed head on a short tapered stem.
item.alt: Rounded bristly seed head drawn in black and white.

item.title: Clustered Houses and Boats
item.description: A black line drawing of clustered houses among curved boat-like forms above a textured field.
item.alt: Black line drawing of clustered houses and small boat-like forms.

item.title: Contour-Pattern Fish
item.description: A black line drawing of a fish filled with dense wavy contour patterns.
item.alt: Black line drawing of a fish filled with wavy contour patterns.

item.title: Gateway and Orange Sun
item.description: A yellow stone gateway and wall stand beneath a large orange sun against a blue background.
item.alt: Yellow stone gateway beneath a large orange sun on blue.

item.title: Geometric Kite over Rocks
item.description: A black line drawing of a striped geometric kite above a small dotted rocky mound.
item.alt: Striped geometric kite above a small rocky mound.

item.title: Hillside Buildings
item.description: White rectangular buildings are stacked along a steep black-and-white hillside against bright blue.
item.alt: White buildings stacked on a steep hillside against a blue background.

item.title: Horse's Head
item.description: A soft monochrome pencil sketch of a horse's head in side view.
item.alt: Monochrome pencil sketch of a horse's head in profile.

item.title: Layered Leaves
item.description: Several overlapping angular leaves appear in muted grey and brown on a blue-grey ground.
item.alt: Overlapping grey and brown leaves on a blue-grey background.

item.title: Leafy Stem and Flower
item.description: A black line drawing of a leafy stem ending in an abstract hanging bloom.
item.alt: Black line drawing of a leafy stem with an abstract hanging flower.

item.title: Orange Fish and Branch
item.description: An orange fish-shaped figure appears above a dark branch with small green leaves.
item.alt: Orange fish-shaped figure above a leafy branch on a dark background.

item.title: Patterned Fish
item.description: A black line drawing of a curved fish with patterned scales and long fins.
item.alt: Black line drawing of a curved fish with patterned scales and fins.

item.title: Pink Bird
item.description: A flat graphic of a pink bird with orange and pale blue accents on black.
item.alt: Pink bird with orange and pale blue accents on a black background.

item.title: Radial Flower Motif
item.description: A blue-and-cream radial flower form with a dark circular centre on a textured grey background.
item.alt: Blue-and-cream radial flower motif with a dark centre on grey.

item.title: Sailboat under Clouds
item.description: A small black sailboat with tan sails sits on bright blue water beneath rounded tan and red cloud forms.
item.alt: Small sailboat with tan sails beneath rounded clouds on a blue field.

item.title: Seahorse
item.description: A detailed black line drawing of a seahorse with a curled tail and fringed crest.
item.alt: Detailed black line drawing of a seahorse with a curled tail.

item.title: Small Bird with Raised Wings
item.description: A black line drawing of a small bird with both wings lifted.
item.alt: Black line drawing of a small bird with both wings raised.

item.title: Tapered Seed Cluster
item.description: A pencil sketch of a tapered cluster of small round seeds on a curved stalk.
item.alt: Pencil drawing of a tapered seed cluster on a curved stalk.

item.title: Teapot, Cup and Fruit
item.description: A black line drawing of a striped teapot, cup and saucer with three round fruits.
item.alt: Striped teapot with a cup, saucer and three round fruits.

item.title: Tree above Water
item.description: A black line drawing of a leafy tree above horizontal water lines, with a fish below the trunk.
item.alt: Leafy tree above rippling water with a fish beneath the trunk.
